CustomField.label: Allow Import
CustomField.description: Lets users import a CSV or Excel file. Rows with a record Id update that record; rows without one create a new record, so Allow New Records must be checked too. Only the grid's editable columns are written; users need edit or create access to the object.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to let users import a CSV or Excel file to update or create records. Needs Allow New Records checked too.
